title.narrative: Significant strides were registered in Early Childhood Development (ECD) at national level and sub-national level in the first half of 2024. Achievements included strengthened National Technical ECD Committee, developing Basic Requirements and Minimum Standards for ECE centers, and formulating a costed National Integrated ECD strategy. Continuous Professional Development for 1,136 caregivers/teachers, installation of 36 out of the planned 72 playgrounds and organizing Uganda National Play Day. The Caring for the Caregiver package was rolled out reaching 240 caregivers with young children. Increased enrollment to 47,840 children and improved knowledge of caregivers on ECD pedagogy at 1,185 centers was registered.
